package fixture

// A function named for an authorization question. Whatever its body does, the name says this code
// decides whether something is permitted — and that decision belongs to the PDP (invariant 2).
type user struct{ roles []string }

func hasPermission(u user, action string) bool {
	for _, r := range u.roles {
		if r == action {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
